title: Line spacing 150 %
description: Two lines H / H in Lato Bold, 10 mm, aligned left, line spacing 150 %: the height of the stitches is one line pitch plus one capital height.

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md, Next 11: line spacing in %, default 100

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (File > New), with Lato Bold (crates/openstitch-design/fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf, OFL) installed for the current Windows user and used as a TrueType font. Add the text H, Enter, H (two lines), size 10.0 mm, alignment Left, line spacing 150 %, colour 800 RED, region Fill Stitch at its defaults, line Not Sewn. Save As PES (default type) as compat/reference/text/text-line-spacing-150.pes and record in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json the PE-DESIGN version, date, OS, the font as PE lists it, every Text Attributes value and every setting you changed (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
